{{Top}}
The '''sensor officer''', '''sensor operator'''<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> or '''sensor specialist'''<ref name="CCG-Serper">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Wyron Serper}}</ref> was a military crewman aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. One of their primary duties was to watch the [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]] of the ship.
